ledger.claim: The charge stands or falls on POL-NS-01, and that clause is conjunctive: the platform must carry every one of limbs (a) to (d), including limb (c), a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force. Trip_record.platform_policy fixes that period for this BUTTON-marker trip at free_wait_sec = 180 seconds, and no_show_threshold_sec is null, so nothing lengthens it. The driver's own derived trace measures the longest continuous in-geofence run at 143 seconds against that 180 second minimum - a 37 second shortfall (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.longest_run_sec, .shortfall_sec, .shortfall_basis = longest_run_sec). Limb (c) therefore fails, and the fee is not chargeable. The run is short on any reading of the minimum: 143 seconds also falls well short of the 300 second figure fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec retains for records authored before policy version 2. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired - weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE - and the shortfall figure rests on the fixes that were in fact recorded; the impairment helps the rider, not the platform, as claim 4 explains.

Once the effective in-geofence dwell falls short, POL-NS-06 is strict liability and the arithmetic is complete: the cancellation fee 'is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and no driver compensation is payable. The shortfall is 37 seconds against the 180 second minimum. The sum to refund is the cancellation-fee line actually charged: EV-FARE-02756 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, and that 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (the net figure), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to complicate the remedy - the rider's contested 4.50 is refunded in full. Disclosure as to the trace the figure comes from: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The only route by which the platform can reach 180 seconds is to add separate in-geofence intervals together, or to credit the 400 second span that bridges them as one continuous run. POL-NS-06(i) forbids both. Summing is permitted only where the trace shows the driver never travelled more than 300 m from the pin AND a present, populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window. EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - so limb (i) is unavailable, and the derived accumulation block itself records both disqualifying conditions (excursion_unmeasurable and advisory_missing). It follows that the two intervals of 60 and 143 seconds cannot be summed to 203, and the 197 second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 cannot be scored as waiting time. The effective dwell remains the 143 seconds the derivation reports, and the gap-based 400 second run is not available to the platform. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; the absence of the advisory is a zero-weight artifact whose absence is itself citable.

The 197 second sampling gap in EV-GPS-02756 sits inside the waiting window (11:33:47 to 11:37:04) and exceeds the 120 second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the artifact is impaired at policy level as well as the 0.39 applied by the pre-pass. That impairment cannot be used to fill the driver's clock: under POL-GEN-02(2) a claim resting on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08 cannot alone support a ruling against the party it disfavours, and the only party who needs the gap treated as served waiting time is the driver, whose own statement is that he waited the full time. Nothing on the rider's side depends on the hole in the trace: the 143 second ceiling is measured from recorded fixes, and POL-NS-06(i) independently refuses to bridge the gap. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

ledger.claim: If, and only if, the judge treats EV-GPS-02756 as the sole evidence for the deciding fact, the fallback relief is escalation, not NO_ACTION. Under POL-NS-08 the ruling could not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND on a deciding fact carried solely by an artifact impaired under limb (b), and the case would escalate under POL-NS-09(e); POL-NS-09 is terminal, issues no monetary ruling, and places the disputed 4.50 on hold rather than collecting it while review is pending, with the reviewer directed to the trace. Even on that fallback the rider is not left funding the charge, and the one outcome that would leave him paying it - NO_ACTION, which under POL-GEN-03 leaves payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0 as they stand - requires the platform to carry limb (c) of POL-NS-01, which the measured 37 second shortfall defeats. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the trip record itself: the record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-25T11:32:47, records no boarding event (started_at and ended_at are both null), and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 11:39:28 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. The record's status of CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER puts the termination on the driver's side of the app, but the reason code and the absence of any boarding put the cause on the rider's side of the facts.

The geofence test of POL-NS-02 is satisfied: the trip is a STANDARD-zone pickup, so the arrival radius is 50 m, and the driver's trace yields 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, the first of them at 11:32:47, which is the arrival event's own timestamp. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 therefore holds on the driver's own evidence. The artifact EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED (weight_multiplier 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE) and I disclose that: the discount prices the trace's coverage and continuity, not the position of the fixes it does carry.

The in-geofence dwell required by POL-NS-01(c) is met. The derived arrival block records a continuous qualifying run of 400 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 11:32:47 to 11:39:27, on 22 qualifying fixes, against a free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) - a margin of 220 seconds. The artifact EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED (weight_multiplier 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), which I disclose in this claim as required: the discount is on the trace's coverage, and an impairment of coverage does not shorten a run the derived block reports at 400 seconds.

The dwell is corroborated from an independent carrier, which matters for the confidence arithmetic. EV-TRIP-02756 is a separate artifact and carries the platform's own wait timer: arrived 11:32:47 to cancelled 11:39:28 is 401 seconds, and wait_time_min is recorded as 6.7. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is the MAXIMUM weight among the independent artifacts that carry the deciding fact, not the minimum - and EV-TRIP-02756 carries weight 1.0 - so a trace impairment of 0.39 does not, on its own, drop this case below the 0.70 escalation floor of POL-NS-09(a). (EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; disclosed here too.)

The rider cannot convert the trace's sampling gap into an absence. The only break in the run is a 197 second gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 across which the recorded straight-line displacement is 0.0 km, and the excursion record carries max_distance_m null with gap_in_interval true - the trace does not show the driver leaving the arrival radius at any point. Limb (i) of POL-NS-06, which exists to let SEPARATE in-geofence intervals be summed where the trace shows the driver leaving and re-entering, is therefore not engaged: there is no recorded departure to excuse and no sum the driver needs performed. The artifact EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED (weight_multiplier 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), which I disclose; the discount is on the trace's continuity, and no fix in it places the driver outside the radius.

The false-arrival test of POL-NS-05 is not met. dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0 and the arrival event timestamp (11:32:47) is identical to the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the marker did not pre-empt the geofence - it fired at the moment the trace first places the driver inside the radius. Nothing in the derived facts places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or in motion at 15 km/h or above, at that timestamp; and on POL-NS-05 limb (iii) a marker is not by itself a ground to void the fee where the corrected dwell still meets the minimum, as the 400 second run does. The artifact EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED (weight_multiplier 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), disclosed here.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window; this trip's chat log holds 0 messages with sequence numbering intact and read receipts present, and the trip record records 0 chat messages and an empty in_app_calls list. Limb (a) fails, so the clause does not apply at all, and the rider cannot reach the answered-message route.

The absence of a rider track does not rescue the rider either. EV-GPS-02756 carries no rider track (rider_presence available false; rider_fix_count 0), so limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is UNDECIDABLE and neutral under POL-NS-11: it is neither satisfied nor failed, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and - notwithstanding POL-NS-08(b) - the missing rider track is not the evidence for any deciding fact of the clauses that do apply, so it neither impairs the driver's arrival and dwell evidence nor engages POL-NS-09(e). The artifact EV-GPS-02756 is IMPAIRED (weight_multiplier 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), disclosed here as well.

There is no fare defect for the rider to build a refund on. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.50 and equals trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 (and fee_schedule.defaults.cancellation_fee_sgd), so the line reconciles for the purposes of POL-NS-08(d) and no fare-integrity defect arises. total_charged is 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00.

The fee having been earned, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the fee in force: 0.80 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, which is the driver_compensation figure the fare record itself carries. The anti-farming check does not trip on either limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4, and the rate limb is likewise not above 0.08 (0 of 85 completed_trips_30d); no other profile field may be used for that check. The case therefore produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd 3.60 under POL-GEN-03, the rider's charge standing as it presently is because the rider's claim is not supported.

EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT): no advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window. The absence is citable, but it carries a fact for nobody. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated and makes limb (i) unavailable where the artifact is MISSING, and POL-GEN-02 gives a MISSING artifact weight 0.0 and no fact at all - so there is no third-party record of a kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident, and none may be asserted by the rider against this driver.

Even on the alternative reading the rider must adopt - that the effective dwell is the longest single uninterrupted run of 143 seconds, 37 seconds short of the 180 second minimum - the only evidence for that lone deciding fact would be EV-GPS-02756, whose 197 second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 lies inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120 second threshold of POL-NS-08(b) (that artifact is IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE). A case whose only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) cannot yield a full refund: it escalates under POL-NS-09 and the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded. On no reading of this record is the rider entitled to the whole SGD 4.50 back.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the $4.50 charged is real (EV-FARE-02756: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), but neither side can presently establish the fact the fee depends on, so the fee is held rather than collected or refunded.

The case turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180; no_show_threshold_sec null). Arrival itself is not the difficulty: the POL-NS-02 geofence test is met on the fixes the trace does carry - STANDARD zone radius 50 m, 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, the first at 11:32:47, the same moment as the 'arrived' event - and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (nothing places the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at that timestamp), so no false-arrival referral arises. The difficulty is the dwell, and the only artifact that measures it - EV-GPS-02756 - is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and impaired at policy level too under POL-NS-08(b), because its 197-second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 lies inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold.

That gap falls exactly across the stretch that decides limb (c). The admitted in-geofence runs are 60 seconds (11:32:47-11:33:47) and 143 seconds (11:37:04-11:39:27); the longest uninterrupted run is 143 seconds, 37 seconds short of 180. Whether the driver held the geofence throughout the gap - which would make one continuous 400-second dwell and support the fee and a $3.60 payout (80 percent of $4.50) - or left and re-entered - leaving 143 seconds and giving the rider the full $4.50 back under POL-NS-06 - is precisely what the trace does not show. The limb is therefore undecided over the impaired stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor the refund.

I do not accept either way around that. First, the driver's 400-second run and trip_record.wait_time_min 6.7 do not independently establish the dwell: POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, and this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 - which makes the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace - does not apply. The trip record therefore does not carry the dwell fact, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 0.39, not the maximum of 0.39 and 1.0, and the $3.60 compensation cannot be ordered. The driver's statement that he waited the full time is evidence, but it carries no weight_multiplier and no clause of this category makes a counterparty statement the test for limb (c). Second, the 60-second and 143-second intervals cannot be summed: POL-NS-06(i) permits summing only where a present, populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). So 203 seconds cannot be assembled, the 197-second gap cannot be scored as waiting time, and the rider's 143-second shortfall cannot be treated as a decided fact either - it is the reading the trace gives once the gap is refused, but the gap is exactly what could make the dwell sufficient.

Other points, briefly. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds 0 messages, so limb (a) fails (EV-CHAT-02756). The absent rider track leaves limb (c) of POL-NS-04 undecidable and neutral under POL-NS-11, and does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence. The fare line reconciles (4.50 equals 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 85 completed trips in 30 days), and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (both paired-dispute counters 0; no_show_disputes_30d 0). The driver's prior_no_show_flags of 2 is a lifetime counter and context only; it is not a ground of decision and I have not used it.

Why the case escalates. The sole evidence for the deciding fact - the in-geofence dwell - is the impaired trace, so POL-NS-08's closing sentence is engaged and POL-NS-09(e) applies; and because the ruling rests on an artifact at 0.39, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well. Escalation is terminal: no refund and no compensation issue, and the $4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded. The monetary effect is nil; the sums in play, $4.50 and $3.60, are each below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00. Referrals: none - POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07's packet instruction are the only candidates on these facts and neither fires.

The open question for the human reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record for TRP-02756, did the driver remain inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius throughout 11:33:47-11:37:04 (a 400-second continuous dwell, which supports the $4.50 fee and a $3.60 driver payout), or did he leave the radius and re-enter (leaving 143 seconds as the longest run and entitling the rider to a full $4.50 refund under POL-NS-06)?

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
